response.justification: While the candidate possesses over 15 years of diverse software engineering experience, including high-throughput microservices and recent AI infrastructure work, they lack the specific domain expertise required for this Principal-level position. There is no demonstrated track record of architecting enterprise-scale experimentation frameworks, feature-flagging systems, or telemetry infrastructure, which are core responsibilities for this role.
strengths: Over 15 years of polyglot software engineering experience across TypeScript, Node.js, C++, Java, and DLang.
Proven ability to build high-throughput, low-latency microservices, handling millions of requests per second.
Recent hands-on experience building AI-agent infrastructure and developer tooling.
concerns: No visible experience designing or building experimentation, A/B testing, or feature-flagging platforms.
Lacks demonstrated enterprise-scale data aptitude involving statistical methods or advanced telemetry foundations.
Previous Staff/Senior roles at smaller companies may not translate to the scope and scale expected of a Principal (IC6) engineer.
